title: Primary Chat · endurecer el canary del ingress como regression harness
mission: Convert the successful G7 one-shot public-sanitized ingress probe into a bounded reusable regression harness under existing owners. Reuse the deployed worker-lab /api/prometeo-ingress contract; do not create another backend, scheduler, queue, CURRENT or credential surface. The harness must never auto-publish private text and must avoid accidental duplicate canary IDs.
definition_of_done: Move the canary request/validation logic out of the one-shot G7 workflow into a deterministic repository test helper under coordination/portfolio/tests or an equivalent existing test owner.
Provide a bounded GitHub Actions entry that is not triggered on ordinary repository pushes; each real run must derive a fresh request_id and use only explicit PUBLIC_SANITIZED_CANARY text.
Validate HTTP 200, prometeo.ingress-transport-result/v1, queued=true, PUBLIC_SANITIZED_CANARY and an exact durable coordination/portfolio/derived ref before reporting PASS.
Run one fresh regression canary and persist run/job identifiers plus the resulting durable ref as evidence.
Retire or disable the ephemeral .github/workflows/wc-auth-bridge-g7-canary.yml path after the reusable harness is proven, without deleting the historical G7 evidence from git history.
No repository token, workspace secret, signed URL or non-canary private payload may appear in the harness, logs or artifacts.
truth_boundary: Regression harness only. A canary enqueue is not worker completion, and this job grants no scheduling, Current, Human Accepted or Served authority.
